note: Hand-written from the Google Drive API reference for files.list. The operation resolves its folder before it lists it, so this is the first fixture in the directory to describe a call chain: three lookups, one per path segment of Documents/Apollia plus the agent slug, each answered with the id-and-name field mask the client asks for, then the listing itself. A resolution that gained or lost a call would fail on the call count rather than on the reading, which is what no single-answer fixture can see. Not a recording.
